text:
Seismic waves from the epicentre of an earthquake take 100s to reach a point 300km away.
When they arrive, they cause the ground to vibrate with a frequency of 2.0Hz.
What is the wavelength of these seismic waves?
A
0.67km
B
1.5km
C
3.0km
D
6.0km
subject: Physics
